description: This file defines an API endpoint class 'CatalogTypeListEndpoint' in a minimal API pattern, responsible for listing catalog types. It implements route addition and request handling logic, using dependency injection for dependencies like IMapper and IRepository, and returns a structured response containing catalog types.

classes.name: CatalogTypeListEndpoint
classes.description: API endpoint class for listing catalog types, implementing route addition and handling asynchronous data retrieval.
